references.label: Center pocket
references.description: Central scoring pocket that advances from 1K through 3K and 5K to 10K.

references.label: Pocket blocker
references.description: Single center target that must be down before the center pocket can accept the ball.

references.label: Center post
references.description: Post between the flippers that can hold a ball for controlled micro flips.

references.label: Post-lowering button
references.description: Small rollover directly above the center post that lowers it when scored.

references.label: A-B standups
references.description: Upper standups that open the lower-right gate when both are collected.

references.label: Side saucers
references.description: Side pockets raised together by the synchronized numbered rollovers.
